#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;

void fft(vector<double>& a, vector<double>& b, bool inverse) {
    int n = a.size();
    int shift = 32 - (int)log2(n);

    // Bit-reverse permutation
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int j = 0;
        int x = i;
        for (int k = 0; k < shift; k++) {
            j = (j << 1) | (x & 1);
            x >>= 1;
        }
        if (i < j) {
            swap(a[i], a[j]);
            swap(b[i], b[j]);
        }
    }

    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        double angle = 2 * M_PI / len * (inverse ? -1 : 1);
        vector<double> wlen_cos(len / 2);
        vector<double> wlen_sin(len / 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            wlen_cos[i] = cos(i * angle);
            wlen_sin[i] = sin(i * angle);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            for (int j = 0; j < len / 2; j++) {
                double uA = a[i + j];
                double uB = b[i + j];

                double vA = a[i + j + len / 2] * wlen_cos[j] - b[i + j + len / 2] * wlen_sin[j];
                double vB = a[i + j + len / 2] * wlen_sin[j] + b[i + j + len / 2] * wlen_cos[j];

                a[i + j] = uA + vA;
                b[i + j] = uB + vB;
                a[i + j + len / 2] = uA - vA;
                b[i + j + len / 2] = uB - vB;
            }
        }
    }

    if (inverse) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] /= n;
            b[i] /= n;
        }
    }
}

vector<int> multiplyMod(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b) {
    int need = (int)a.size() + (int)b.size() - 1;
    int n = 1 << (int)ceil(log2(need));
    vector<double> aReal(n, 0), aImag(n, 0);
    vector<double> bReal(n, 0), bImag(n, 0);

    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
        int x = (a[i] % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        aReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
        aImag[i] = x >> 15;
    }

    fft(aReal, aImag, false);

    // Prepare b
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); i++) {
        int x = (b[i] % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        bReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
        bImag[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    fft(bReal, bImag, false);

    vector<double> faReal(n), faImag(n), fbReal(n), fbImag(n);
    double cf = 0.25 / n;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);

        double a1r = aReal[i] + aReal[j];
        double a1i = aImaginary[i] - aImaginary[j];
        double a2r = aImaginary[i] + aImaginary[j];
        double a2i = aReal[j] - aReal[i];

        double b1r = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) * cf;
        double b1i = (bImaginary[i] - bImaginary[j]) * cf;
        double b2r = (bImaginary[i] + bImaginary[j]) * cf;
        double b2i = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) * cf;

        faReal[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        faImag[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        fbReal[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        fbImag[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }

    fft(faReal, faImag, true);
    fft(fbReal, fbImag, true);

    vector<int> result(need);
    for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
        long long aa = (long long)(faReal[i] + 0.5);

    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    vector<int> v(10, 0);
